briefing: Markets were neutral today, with NASDAQ down 0.6% and the S&P 500 down 0.3% — no clear risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($289.29) is below the $500 deployment threshold, and per past lessons we don't force buys into open slots on a neutral day, so we're holding all 7 positions unchanged and waiting for a genuine risk-on setup.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Patience means resisting the urge to trade just because cash or open slots are available. On neutral days without strong bullish signals, holding cash and waiting for a genuine opportunity often protects returns better than forcing a trade.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 耐心是指不因為手上有現金或空餘倉位，就急於進場交易。在缺乏強烈看漲訊號的中性交易日，持有現金並耐心等待真正的機會，往往比勉強進場更能保護投資報酬。

market_education.summary_en: Both major indices drifted slightly lower today in a quiet, directionless session, with NASDAQ -0.6% and the S&P 500 -0.3%. There was no strong catalyst pushing markets meaningfully in either direction, which is typical of consolidation phases after recent moves. Days like this often see institutional investors sit on the sidelines waiting for clearer signals before committing new capital.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日兩大指數皆小幅下跌，走勢平淡缺乏方向，納斯達克下跌0.6%，標普500下跌0.3%。市場並無明顯催化劑推動大幅波動，這種情況在近期走勢過後的整理階段相當常見。這類交易日中，機構投資者通常會選擇觀望，待訊號更明確後才會投入新資金。
